title: One key for every lock
style_lock: flat cel-shaded TV sitcom animation, rounded soft characters with oversized heads, big oval eyes with small dot pupils, thick even black outlines, flat colours with almost no shading, clean flat pastel backgrounds, simple furniture, even sitcom lighting, wide level camera, original characters only

cast.name: Rita
cast.description: a cheerful bakery owner in her forties with a flour-dusted pink apron, curly red hair in a bun and a pencil behind one ear

cast.name: Max
cast.description: her 12-year-old son, small and calm, round green glasses, a yellow hoodie, always holding a phone

cast.name: Pebble
cast.description: a smooth grey pebble-shaped robot the size of a cat, with a glowing teal ring for a face and two tiny arms

locations.name: bakery back office
locations.description: a small back office behind a bakery: a cluttered desk with an old laptop, shelves of flour sacks, a window into the shop with cakes on display, sticky notes all over the wall and the laptop

locations.name: key vault cutaway
locations.description: a huge round vault door standing open in a calm teal space, rows of glowing keys hanging neatly inside

beats.scene: Rita stands at the desk covered from head to toe in blank sticky notes, the laptop screen glowing red
beats.motion: Rita peels sticky notes off her arms one by one, more fall from the wall, Max sighs

lines.speaker: rita
lines.text: I use the same password everywhere. It's my cat's name.

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Mum. Everyone knows your cat's name.

beats.caption: Same password everywhere?

beats.scene: Max holds his phone up like a teacher; on its screen, a row of identical keys all opening different doors
beats.motion: Max taps the phone and the keys light up one after another, Rita leans in

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: If one site leaks it, every door opens. Email, bank, the bakery's orders.

beats.caption: One leak opens every door

beats.scene: Pebble rolls into the open vault and hangs a different glowing key on each hook
beats.action: Pebble holds up one golden master key
beats.motion: Pebble rolls along the rows hanging keys, then turns and holds up the golden key

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: A password manager makes a different strong key for every lock, and keeps them all safe.

beats.caption: A different key for every lock

beats.scene: Rita sits at the clean desk, the wall now bare, Pebble beside the laptop with its ring glowing teal
beats.motion: Rita taps one button, the laptop screen turns green, she throws her arms up happily

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: You remember one strong password. It remembers the rest.

lines.speaker: rita
lines.text: One password? I can do one!

beats.caption: Remember one. It remembers the rest.

beats.scene: Max faces the camera front and centre, deadpan, one finger raised; Rita behind him happily icing a cake
beats.motion: Max nods once and points down at the bottom of the frame

lines.speaker: max
lines.text: Set one up today. Comment KEYS and we'll send the beginner's checklist.

beats.caption: Comment KEYS for the checklist
